sealed.data: every file under data/ whose name ends in .ndjson
sealed.meta: data/meta.json with its digest key removed, re-serialised as canonical JSON
sealed.rule: one line per sealed file, SHA-256 hex, two spaces, the relative path, then a newline; lines sorted by bytes; the digest is the SHA-256 of the sorted lines; the canonical meta is serialised with sorted keys, no spaces after separators, non-ASCII kept, and one trailing newline

state: The House index layer and the transaction reports behind it. 441 seats of the 119th Congress, 439 of them filled and 2 vacant; 1,197 filings attributed to 428 sitting members from the Clerk's 2025 filing index, retrieved 2026-09-22, 101 of them settled by the document's own header where the name alone could not. 1,737 index rows are not attributed, each with a reason: 1,575 because no sitting member has this name; the row is a candidate or a former member, and 162 held for a person to decide because the surname matches a sitting member. The index lists 4 DocIDs more than once, identically; the register keeps one row for each. Of the 463 transaction reports attributed, 409 were read from the Clerk's documents and 7,346 transactions written, each checked against the seat and Filing ID printed in its report; 54 are scanned paper filings the register captured, hashed and does not read; 3 of the 409 print a seat other than the roster's and carry that discrepancy on the row. 55 annual reports and other forms behind attributed rows had their headers read and hashed; their schedules are not yet read, and no holdings are. 11 sitting members have no filing attributed. The Signal Periodic Transaction Report filed after the STOCK Act deadline (sg:stock-act-late-ptr:v1) evaluated 6,816 rows on the 409 reports it read and found 1,292 of them dated by the Clerk's index after the deadline the rule sets, on 29 reports attributed to 22 officeholders; 530 rows were not evaluated, each with a reason, and 54 reports were not read. The ledger holds 29 Findings. Those gaps are counted, not hidden. Presence in this register is not evidence of wrongdoing.
